StatusPalAPIKeyCredential.title: StatusPalAPIKeyCredential
StatusPalAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Supply an existing API key, region and selected organization ID. Authorization contains the raw key, without Bearer. Only protected organization status-page/service reads are exposed. Parsed catalog access, including an empty page, proves reachability; it does not identify a principal or prove organization ownership, all permissions, plan or private access. No key creation/exchange/refresh or environment fallback.
